sentences.text:
(Sunil Kumar Uikey Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh ) Dated : 14-08-2024 Shri
Abhinav Dubey - Advocate with Shri Akash Kaushal - Advocate for appellant.
Smt. Geeta Yadav - Government Advocate for the State.
Record of the Court below has been received.
Heard on admission.
This appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A No.7337/2024 , which is second application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellants.
His earlier application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 11.10.2023.
The appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years and fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the conviction and sentence passed by the learned trial Court is illegal, arbitrary and contrary to 2 CRA-4379-2022 the evidence available on record.
There are contradiction and omissions in the testimonies of prosecution witnesses.
The appellant is in custody and the appeal would take considerable time to conclude.
He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.

Hence,
it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be considered.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and prays for its rejection.
Heard counsel for the parties, perused the judgment and record of the Court below.

Having heard the arguments and on perusal of the record, this Court is of the considered opinion that till disposal of this appeal, execution of jail sentence awarded to the appellant under the Sunil Kumar Uikey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57596855/
1 impugned judgment deserves to be suspended.

sentences.text: Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 21.11.2024 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
3 CRA-4379-2022 Accordingly, the aforesaid I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.
List this criminal appeal for final hearing in due course.
